sources.label: Mighty Morphing Joey patches!
sources.author: Mighty Morphing
patch_list: Backup and restore

[v1.3: Morphe settings covers splash, theme, comments, and show and hide] Save Joey settings to a file and restore them later. Log in to the same Reddit account before restoring subscriptions. Access via Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.
Disable tooltips
Turns off the first-run tips Joey shows.
Dismiss without tearing
Swiping a photo away to close it looks smooth instead of tearing.
Editor image and GIF upload

Uploads images and GIFs to Reddit directly when adding comments. Both can be uploaded via the image button. Also adds keyboard gif auto upload to reddit (click markdown in editor (far left icon) to enable keyboard gif support).
Fix login page
Makes Reddit's login page load and work properly inside Joey, and clears the cookie banner out of the way.
Inline comment media

[v1.3: Scroll up or down on comment images, GIFs, and videos] Shows GIFs, pictures, subreddit emojis and reddit videos inline in the comments instead of as links. Tap to open. Drag left or right to resize, as usual. YouTube links use a 16:…
Log in with your own client ID

Lets Joey log in with another app's client ID, for when Joey's own login stops working. Normal option here is to sign in to RedReader once, then paste the App ID from Reddit's "you authorized an app" email into this patch's settings in exp…
Modern UI

[v1.3: A modern refresh of Joey's look] Joey's own themes and colour changes are turned off while this patch is on. Aqua is the default. Blue, Purple, Coral, Mint, Gold, Amber, Black, Sky, and AMOLED black are in Joey Settings - Morphe Set…
Open Reddit share links

Opens modern Reddit share links directly to the right post or comment in Joey instead of loading the web page. To open Reddit links from other apps, make sure all links are ticked in Android Settings -> Apps -> Joey -> Open by default.
RedGifs with sound
RedGifs clips play with their sound, in HD when it's available.
Search auto open keyboard
Opens the keyboard automatically for homepage search and comment search. The Enter and Search keys start the search.
Show/Hide

[v1.3: Drag the handle to reorder] Choose which comment editor buttons, sidebar entries, subreddit toolbar items, and post actions are shown. What does not fit on a post goes in its menu. Adjust viewable options in Joey Settings - Morphe S…
Skip ads and checks
Removes ads everywhere and also drops the Play Store install check and crash reporting.
Splash Screen
Logo inspired by u/otheast. Animation and colours are fully customisable in Joey Settings - Morphe Settings.
Subreddit filter options
Adds a subreddit suffix filter and lets you toggle subreddit filters on or off without deleting them. Configure in Joey - Settings - Filters, or from the feed Filter out posts menu.
